gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with IDH-mutant Astrocytoma, CNS WHO-Grade 4, newly diagnosed (by biopsy or incomplete tumor resection)

candidate_evidence.quote: [OTHER] Psychological intervention: The intervention will include a psychological intervention with counseling sessions (online/video intervention) and telephone follow-up additionally to the care as usual.

role_evidence.quote: Patients eligible for radiochemotherapy with temozolomide and 60 Gy

coder_notes: Psychological telehealth intervention to improve TTFields compliance (phase NA). Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but all patients receive standard radiochemotherapy with temozolomide, so it is listed as soc_backbone. TTFields is a device and not listed. IDH-mutant astrocytoma grade 4 listed separately from glioblastoma (CNS5-style), but no WHO 2021 citation or IDH-wildtype requirement -> cns5_terminology unclear. IDH appears only as a population descriptor, not recorded as a selection biomarker. Optional hair/blood stress and immune samples are not tumour biomarkers.
